home.docTitle: Ludus Atlas — Historical toys & games (Akkadian gloss)
home.headline: Mēlultu u ṣābītu ša kal mātāti.
home.sub: Kisru mēlulti ina tār awīlūti—ṭuppu, kakku, qû, ṣalamtu, isinnu—mēlultu ištēt kīma šanâti mātāti, lā šanûtu.
home.featuredSub: Mancala, ṣēṣ, mills, shuttlecocks—mēlultu ištēt, šanâti mātāti ina aḫāmiš.

guide.sub: Qibi mīna taḫšḫu mēlulti—milku ina kisri annî ina parṣī, aṣê, šanâti, u šîmi.

guide.scope: Ina Ludus Atlas: mēlulti amur, idê, mēlulta aḫuz, šîma āmur.

chat.welcome:
Anāku Atlas ālik pāni—rēṣuka ana kisri mēlulti u ṣābīti labīrāti. Migra ašâl, arkānu milka addan. Têleʾʾe šâl akī mēlulti, aṣâ, šanâti, ū šîma.

Mīnût awīlī ina mēlulti?
chat.outOfScope: Ina Ludus Atlas ašakkan—mēlulti buʾû, akī ippušū, tēm māti, akī mēlulti, ašar šâmi. Ina ḫarrāni annî šâl, ū qibi “ištu rēši epuš”.
chat.askSetting: Got it. Indoor table play, outdoor/active play, or either?
chat.askVibe: What kind of experience are you after?
chat.askRegion: Any region or civilization you lean toward? (or say worldwide)
chat.hint.preference: Say a preference, ask about a game, or tap a quick reply.
chat.hint.players: I didn’t catch the group size. Alone, 2, 3–4, a larger group, or any?
chat.hint.setting: Choose indoor, outdoor, or either—and we’ll keep going.
chat.askPurchaseWhich: Which game do you want purchase links for?
chat.askAbout: Name a game from the catalog and I’ll share its origin and story.
chat.askVariations: Name a game and I’ll list its cultural variations.
chat.askHowToPlayWhich: Ayû mēlultu lušāhiz? Šumšu qibi, ū lū ina milki elûti šâl.
chat.askRequirements: Ayî mēlulti ḫišīḫtu ū lū mīnût ṣābê luparras?
chat.askCompare: Šinā mēlulti kisri ana muḫḫuri qibi (kīma “muḫḫir Go u Ṣēṣ”).
chat.rec.none: Mitḫurti dannati ul āmur{prefLine}. Māta ana “ayimma” ruppiš, ū qibi “ištu rēši epuš”.
chat.rec.intro: Annumma {n} nigûtū ina kisri{prefLine}. Šuma ina kisri luput, ū šâl akī mēlulti, aṣî, šanâti, ašar šâmi. Luput “More recommendations” ana šalāštim šanîtim.
chat.answer.purchaseNone: Adīni rikis bītātīya ana **{name}** ul ibašši. Ṭuppa kisri petê têleʾʾe.
chat.answer.variationsNone: **{name}** kīma nabnīt ēdiššīša balu šanâti qerbeti ina kisri šaṭrat.
chat.answer.variations:
Šanâti mātāti ša **{name}** (mēlultu ištēt, pānū šanûtu):
{lines}
chat.answer.aboutFollowup:
{about}

Akī mēlulti luparris, ḫišīḫta limnu, šanâti lukallim, ū lū rikis šîmi lušārik.
chat.answer.compare:
**{a}** muḫḫur **{b}**

• Aṣû: {aOrigin} ({aYear}) muḫḫur {bOrigin} ({bYear})
• Ṣābū: {aPlayers} muḫḫur {bPlayers}
• Isqu: {aCategory} muḫḫur {bCategory}

{a}: {aDesc}…

{b}: {bDesc}…

Šâl akī mēlulti ištēt, ū lū rikis šîmi.
chat.answer.fallback:
Ina kisri annî mēlulti lumlik, akī mēlulti luparris, aṣâ u šanâti lušārik, ū lū ṭuppāt šîmi lukallim.

Šitūl: “mēlulti milki ana 2 ištu Ašia šadî”, “akī mancala”. Ū “ištu rēši epuš”.
detail.variationsIntro: Fundamentally the same game or toy in different places and eras—not separate catalog inventions.
detail.buyIntro: Product pages from different platforms so you can compare by region and shipping.
footer.blurb: Ludus Atlas catalogs toys and games across civilizations—including Mesopotamia. Fundamentally identical forms appear as variations under one entry.
chat.rec.exhausted: Annûtu kal mitḫurū dannūtum ana migrī annûti. Qibi “ištu rēši epuš” ana šanîm, ū šâl šuma elênu.
chat.rec.moreIntro: Annumma {n} nigûtū šanûtum ina kisri{prefLine}. Luput “More recommendations” ana arkî, ū šâl šuma elênu.
detail.assistant.title: Šâl ina mēlulti annîti
detail.assistant.sub: Šâl akī {name} mēlulti, aṣâšu, mīna taḫšḫu, šanâti mātāti, ū ašar šâmi.
detail.assistant.welcome: Anāku ana **{name}**—parṣū, aṣû, ḫišḫū, šanâti, u ṭuppāt šîmi ina kisri annî. Mīna tidê?
detail.assistant.hint: Šâl mīnamme ina {name} ina kisri annî—parṣū, aṣû, unūtū, šanâti, ū šîmu.
detail.assistant.outOfScope: Ina Ludus Atlas u mēlulti ṭuppi annîti, **{name}**, azzaz. Parṣī, aṣâ, ḫišḫī, šanâti, ū šîma luparris—ina qerbīšu šâl.
detail.assistant.otherGame: Ṭuppu annû ina **{name}**. Ana ṭuppi annîti apâl; ana šumim šanîm pete ṭuppašu ū Atlas ālik pāni āmur.
detail.assistant.useGuide: Ana mēlulti šanâti amārim Atlas ālik pāni ūbil. Ina annîti **{name}** kīma ištēt—parṣū, aṣû, unūtū, šanâti, ū šîmu.
